resources.string: Double-tap lock widget. Private by design: no accessibility access, no internet, never reads your screen.
Resizable lock zone — double-tap it to lock your phone instantly. Place it anywhere and resize freely. No accessibility permission; it can never read your screen.

Quick Lock uses device admin only to lock the screen (force-lock). It cannot read your screen or notifications, cannot access your data, cannot wipe the device, and has no internet permission. You can revoke it at any time in Android Settings.

1. Long-press your home screen → Widgets → add “Quick Lock”. You can add it several times to create multiple lock zones.
2. Drag it anywhere you want quick access, then resize it freely (long-press the widget → drag the resize handles).
3. Double-tap the area to lock the phone instantly.
4. Optional extra triggers: the “Lock screen” Quick Settings tile, or long-press the app icon → “Lock screen” shortcut.

Why this app is safe:

• It does NOT use the accessibility service — the permission that lets other apps read your screen, OTPs and notifications. Without it, this app physically cannot read anything on your screen.

• It has NO internet permission — it cannot send any data anywhere, ever.

• Device admin is granted with the “force lock” policy only: the app can lock the screen and do nothing else (no wipe, no password changes, no camera/mic). Revoke it anytime under Settings → Security → Device admin apps.

• Zero battery impact: the widget reacts only to your taps (updatePeriodMillis = 0). No background services, no alarms, no boot receivers, no wake locks.

• Every app screen is FLAG_SECURE — it cannot appear in screenshots or screen recordings, so an eavesdropper recording your screen cannot capture this app’s UI.

• It collects, stores and shares no data. Settings live only on this device (private storage, excluded from backup/transfer).

• All exported components are explicitly declared; custom lock intents are accepted only from this app or the system; all PendingIntents are immutable.

Quick Lock 1.0.0 — open source: github.com/solerunner26/LockScreenWidget

Permissions used: VIBRATE only (lock-confirmation buzz).
Device admin: force-lock only.
No internet permission, no accessibility service, no analytics, no ads.
Works on Android 8.0+ including the latest Android beta releases.
